_comment: Pre-handoff gate allowlist (pre-handoff-checks plan 5.2, D13). No values, ever: path + rule + key or line_hint only.
Entry: { target, path (target-relative) | paths (docs-dup group), rule, key | line_hint, reason, owner, proposed, expires }.
Dev Bot proposes entries with a reason and expiry; a real credential needs Neil's OK; Review Bot checks new entries every round. Expired entries fail the gate.
No entries for the API.Framework dev secrets (D1: removed by T-GATE-008).
